calls.query: {"cmd": "cat AGENTS.md; for dir in metrics .github .github/prompts; do if [ -f \"$dir/AGENTS.md\" ]; then printf '\\n--- %s ---\\n' \"$dir/AGENTS.md\"; cat \"$dir/AGENTS.md\"; fi; done; cat .claude/agents/stats-reviewer.md; rg -n 'prefix_est_grant_rate|prefix_weighted_resolved|sal-v4|bracket|frozen|reached|2017|2025|base.rate|Term' metrics/statpack.md .github/prompts/predict.md", "max_output_tokens": 20000}

{"cmd": "sed -n '330,500p' AGENTS.md; cat .claude/agents/stats-reviewer.md; nl -ba .github/prompts/predict.md | sed -n '1,230p'; nl -ba metrics/statpack.md | sed -n '1,160p'; jq 'keys' metrics/statpack.json", "max_output_tokens": 16500}

{"cmd": "rg -n 'base.rate|prefix|bracket|salience_version|strictly|forward|pool|Term' .github/prompts/predict.md; nl -ba metrics/statpack.md | sed -n '1,82p'; jq '.terms | type, (if type == \"object\" then keys else .[0] end)' metrics/statpack.json; cat .claude/agents/stats-reviewer.md", "max_output_tokens": 9500}

{"cmd": "nl -ba .github/prompts/predict.md | sed -n '250,279p'; nl -ba metrics/statpack.md | sed -n '1,72p'; jq '.terms | type, length' metrics/statpack.json; jq '.terms[0] | keys' metrics/statpack.json", "max_output_tokens": 6000}

{"cmd": "rg -n 'Segment base|reached|rendered|sal-v4|vintage|generated|updated' metrics/statpack.md; jq '.terms[0] | {term,salience_version,segments}' metrics/statpack.json; nl -ba metrics/statpack.md | sed -n '180,210p'; nl -ba .github/prompts/predict.md | sed -n '99,118p'", "max_output_tokens": 5500}

{"cmd": "jq '.terms[0] | {term,salience_version,segments}' metrics/statpack.json; sed -n '189,191p' metrics/statpack.md; jq '[.terms[] | select(.term >= 2017 and .term <= 2025) | {term,salience_version,state:.segments.state}]' metrics/statpack.json", "max_output_tokens": 3500}

{"cmd": "jq '[.terms[] | select(.term >= 2017 and .term <= 2025) | .term as $term | .salience_version as $version | .segments[] | select(.band == \"state\") | {term:$term,salience_version:$version,rate:.prefix_est_grant_rate,weight:.prefix_weighted_resolved,numerator:(.prefix_est_grant_rate * .prefix_weighted_resolved)}] | . as $rows | {rows:$rows,numerator:([$rows[].numerator]|add),denominator:([$rows[].weight]|add),percent:(([$rows[].numerator]|add)/([$rows[].weight]|add)*100)}' metrics/statpa
